items.summary: Wan2.2 offers open large-scale video generative models on GitHub and is pitched as an open-source alternative to VEO 3.

items.title: World’s first Humanoid Robot Games open in Beijing
items.raw_content: The world’s first Humanoid Robot Games opened on Thursday in Beijing. During the three-day event, more than 500 robots from 16 countries and regions will
items.title_zh: 全球首届人形机器人运动会在北京开幕
items.summary: The world's first Humanoid Robot Games opened in Beijing, with more than 500 robots from 16 countries and regions taking part in the three-day event, TechNode reported.

items.title: Perplexity Makes Longshot $34.5B Offer for Chrome
items.title_zh: Perplexity 出价 345 亿美元收购 Chrome，被视为希望渺茫
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that Perplexity has made a $34.5 billion offer for Chrome, a bid the paper describes as a longshot.

items.title: EngineAI to launch SA02, a $5,500 humanoid robot aimed at young people
items.raw_content: Last week, Chinese robotics firm EngineAI announced the upcoming release of the SA02, which the company describes as “the first humanoid robot for young
items.title_zh: EngineAI 将推出 SA02：面向年轻人的 5,500 美元人形机器人
items.summary: Chinese robotics firm EngineAI announced the upcoming release of the SA02, described by the company as the first humanoid robot for young people, priced at $5,500.

items.title: Meta accessed women's health data from Flo app without consent, says court
items.raw_content: A jury has ruled that Meta accessed sensitive information from women's reproductive health tracking app Flo without consent.
items.title_zh: 法院称 Meta 未经同意获取 Flo 应用的女性健康数据
items.summary: A jury has ruled that Meta accessed sensitive information from the women's reproductive health tracking app Flo without consent, according to a report on the case.

items.summary: Wan2.2 offers open large-scale video generative models on GitHub and is pitched as an open-source alternative to VEO 3.

items.title: Perplexity Makes Longshot $34.5B Offer for Chrome
items.title_zh: Perplexity 出价 345 亿美元收购 Chrome，被视为希望渺茫
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that Perplexity has made a $34.5 billion offer for Chrome, a bid the paper describes as a longshot.

items.title: Meta accessed women's health data from Flo app without consent, says court
items.title_zh: 法院称 Meta 未经同意获取 Flo 应用的女性健康数据
items.summary: A jury has ruled that Meta accessed sensitive information from the women's reproductive health tracking app Flo without consent, according to a report on the case.

items.title: AOL to discontinue dial-up internet
items.title_zh: AOL 将停止拨号上网服务
items.summary: AOL is discontinuing its dial-up internet service, according to a New York Times report.

items.title: OpenSSH Post-Quantum Cryptography
items.title_zh: OpenSSH 的后量子密码学
items.summary: OpenSSH has enabled post-quantum key agreement by default since version 9.0, and version 10.0 made the newer mlkem768x25519-sha256 scheme the default.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 4 now supports 1M tokens of context
items.title_zh: Claude Sonnet 4 现支持 100 万 token 上下文
items.summary: Anthropic says Claude Sonnet 4 now supports up to 1 million tokens of context, a fivefold increase that lets users process entire codebases, synthesize large document sets, and build agents that stay coherent across hundreds of tool calls.

items.title: Show HN: Omnara – Run Claude Code from anywhere
items.title_zh: Show HN：Omnara——随时随地运行 Claude Code
items.summary: Omnara is a Show HN project described as an agent command center that lets users launch and control Claude Code sessions from a terminal, web dashboard, or mobile app and switch between them.

items.title: New treatment eliminates bladder cancer in 82% of patients
items.title_zh: 新疗法使 82% 的患者膀胱癌肿瘤消失
items.summary: A phase 2 clinical trial found that the TAR-200 drug-releasing system eliminated tumors in 82% of patients with high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer that had resisted prior treatment. In most cases the cancer disappeared after three months of treatment.

items.title: We caught companies making it harder to delete your personal data online
items.title_zh: 我们发现一些公司在让用户更难删除个人数据
items.summary: The Markup and CalMatters found that dozens of companies were hiding how users can delete their personal data. Several companies stopped the practice after reporters contacted them.

items.title: Kodak has no plans to cease, go out of business, or file for bankruptcy
items.title_zh: 柯达表示没有停业、倒闭或申请破产的计划
items.summary: Kodak published a statement saying it has no plans to cease operations, go out of business, or file for bankruptcy, following what it called misleading media reports.

items.title: Claude Opus 4 and 4.1 can now end a rare subset of conversations
items.title_zh: Claude Opus 4 与 4.1 现可结束极少数对话
items.summary: Anthropic says Claude Opus 4 and 4.1 can now end a rare subset of conversations, an update tied to the company's exploratory research on model welfare.

items.title: The beauty of a text only webpage
items.title_zh: 纯文本网页之美
items.summary: The author celebrates text-only webpages as a refuge from cookie consent banners, intrusive ads and email opt-in prompts.

items.title: How Figma’s multiplayer technology works (2019)
items.title_zh: Figma 多人协作技术是如何工作的（2019）
items.summary: A 2019 Figma engineering post describes the homegrown technology behind its live collaborative editing, which the company describes as the first design tool with multiplayer editing.

items.title: Volkswagen locks horsepower behind paid subscription
items.title_zh: 大众将马力锁进付费订阅
items.summary: Volkswagen now lets owners subscribe to boost the power of their car for a fee, according to Auto Express.

items.title: IQ tests results for AI
items.title_zh: AI的IQ测试成绩
items.summary: TrackingAI compares AI models' IQ scores on the Mensa Norway and Offline tests, and presents rankings, speed, cost, question accuracy and IQ trends.

items.title: Auf Wiedersehen, GitHub
items.title_zh: 再见，GitHub
items.summary: GitHub's CEO says he is stepping down to build his next adventure while describing the company as thriving with a bright future.

items.title: "None of These Books Are Obscene": Judge Strikes Down Much of FL's Book Ban Bill
items.title_zh: “这些书都不淫秽”：法官推翻佛罗里达州图书禁令的大部分内容
items.summary: A judge struck down much of a Florida law that led to hundreds of books being removed from school libraries, in a ruling described as a major win for intellectual freedom.

items.title: A gigantic jet caught on camera: A spritacular moment for NASA astronaut
items.title_zh: NASA 宇航员在空间站拍到巨大喷流
items.summary: NASA astronaut Nichole Ayers captured a rare gigantic jet from the International Space Station on July 3, 2025, a lightning discharge shooting from a storm top into the upper atmosphere.

items.title: World’s first Humanoid Robot Games open in Beijing
items.title_zh: 全球首届人形机器人运动会在北京开幕
items.summary: The world's first Humanoid Robot Games opened in Beijing, with more than 500 robots from 16 countries and regions taking part in the three-day event, TechNode reported.

items.title: EngineAI to launch SA02, a $5,500 humanoid robot aimed at young people
items.title_zh: EngineAI 将推出 SA02：面向年轻人的 5,500 美元人形机器人
items.summary: Chinese robotics firm EngineAI announced the upcoming release of the SA02, described by the company as the first humanoid robot for young people, priced at $5,500.

items.title: China’s NIO hires hundreds of sales staff in hope of sales boost, executive says
items.title_zh: 蔚来一个月增聘数百名销售人员，高管称希望提振销量
items.summary: Chinese EV maker NIO added 800 sales workers in a month, many of them from Porsche's Chinese dealerships, an executive said, as the company seeks a sales boost.

items.title: Visionox tops out world’s first FMM-free 8.6-gen AMOLED line with $7.7 billion investment
items.title_zh: 维信诺全球首条无 FMM 8.6 代 AMOLED 生产线主体封顶，投资 77 亿美元
items.summary: Visionox announced that the main building of its 8.6-generation AMOLED production line, built with investment from Hefei, has been completed; the project is described as the world's first FMM-free line of its generation, with $7.7 billion in investment.

items.title: Micron cuts jobs in China, shifts focus away from mobile NAND
items.title_zh: 美光在中国裁员，重心移出移动 NAND
items.summary: Following reports of layoffs across its China operations, Micron said the workforce adjustments were driven by a shift away from mobile NAND.

items.title: DeepSeek denies rumors of August launch for R2 AI model
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 否认 R2 AI 模型将于 8 月发布的传闻
items.summary: DeepSeek denied renewed market speculation that its next-generation DeepSeek-R2 model would launch in August, according to TechNode.

items.title: Trump meets and praises Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan, just five days after demanding his resignation
items.title_zh: 特朗普会见并称赞 Intel CEO 陈立武，距要求其辞职仅五天
items.summary: US President Trump met Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan at the White House on Monday for in-depth discussions on the semiconductor industry, just five days after demanding his resignation, TechNode reports.

items.title: China’s Northwestern Polytechnical University develops world’s first miniature soft robot capable of operating at -50°C
items.title_zh: 西工大联合港校研发全球首款可在 -50°C 工作的微型软体机器人
items.summary: Northwestern Polytechnical University, together with City University of Hong Kong and Hong Kong Polytechnic University, announced a miniature soft robot it describes as the first able to operate at minus 50 degrees Celsius.

items.title: MiHoYo’s Zenless Zone Zero teams up with Aston Martin for Gamescom 2025
items.title_zh: 米哈游《绝区零》联手阿斯顿·马丁亮相2025科隆游戏展
items.summary: MiHoYo's action game Zenless Zone Zero announced a collaboration with British luxury sports car brand Aston Martin for Gamescom 2025. The tie-in is scheduled to run from August 20 to 24.

items.title: Francis-Rings/StableAvatar
items.title_zh: Francis-Rings/StableAvatar：端到端音频驱动虚拟人视频扩散模型
items.summary: The repository presents StableAvatar, described as the first end-to-end video diffusion transformer that synthesizes infinite-length, high-quality audio-driven avatar videos from a reference image and audio without post-processing.

items.title: LyraVoid/Mizuki
items.title_zh: LyraVoid/Mizuki
items.summary: An Astro-powered blog theme built around Material Design 3, described by its author as a next-generation theme.

items.title: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan-GameCraft-1.0
items.title_zh: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan-GameCraft-1.0：高动态交互式游戏视频生成
items.summary: Hunyuan-GameCraft is a Python project for high-dynamic interactive game video generation using a hybrid history condition.

items.title: MeiGen-AI/InfiniteTalk
items.title_zh: InfiniteTalk：支持无限时长说话视频生成
items.summary: InfiniteTalk generates talking videos of unlimited length and supports both image-to-video and video-to-video generation.

items.title: BehiSecc/First-Bounty
items.title_zh: BehiSecc/First-Bounty：从零赚到第一笔赏金的路线图
items.summary: First-Bounty is a beginner-friendly bug bounty roadmap that aims to take learners from no experience to earning their first bounty.

items.title: CodeGraphContext/CodeGraphContext
items.title_zh: CodeGraphContext：为 AI 助手构建代码图谱
items.summary: CodeGraphContext is an MCP server and CLI tool that indexes local code into a graph database to provide context to AI assistants.

items.title: 666ghj/DeepSearchAgent-Demo
items.title_zh: DeepSearchAgent-Demo：从零实现深度搜索智能体
items.summary: DeepSearchAgent-Demo is a Python project that implements a concise deep search agent from scratch.

items.title: wesammustafa/Claude-Code-Everything-You-Need-to-Know
items.title_zh: Claude Code完全指南：从入门到进阶
items.summary: An independent community guide to Claude Code organized into three levels from beginner to advanced, with hands-on lessons, checked exercises and sourced citations for volatile facts.

items.title: minitap-ai/mobile-use
items.title_zh: mobile-use：让 AI 智能体操作手机应用
items.summary: mobile-use is a Python project that lets AI agents use real Android and iOS apps the way a human would.

items.title: osaurus-ai/osaurus
items.title_zh: Osaurus：macOS原生AI智能体运行框架
items.summary: Osaurus is an open-source, native macOS harness for AI agents supporting any model, persistent memory, autonomous execution and cryptographic identity. It is written in Swift and designed to run fully offline.

items.title: CObL: Toward Zero-Shot Ordinal Layering without User Prompting
items.title_zh: CObL：无需用户提示的零样本序数分层
items.summary: CObL is a diffusion-based architecture that generates an occlusion-ordered stack of object layers in parallel from an image, using Stable Diffusion as a prior. Trained on a few thousand synthetic tabletop scenes, it zero-shot generalizes to photographs of real tabletop scenes with novel objects.

items.title: Understanding Dementia Speech Alignment with Diffusion-Based Image Generation
items.title_zh: 理解痴呆症语音与扩散模型图像生成之间的对齐
items.summary: Researchers examined whether text-to-image diffusion models can align dementia-related speech with generated images, finding that dementia detection was possible from generated images alone with 75% accuracy on the ADReSS dataset, and used explainability methods to identify which language contributed.

items.title: Predictive Multimodal Modeling of Diagnoses and Treatments in EHR
items.title_zh: 电子病历中诊断与治疗的多模态预测建模
items.summary: The authors propose a multimodal system that fuses clinical notes and tabular events from electronic health records using pre-trained encoders, feature pooling, and cross-modal attention for early prediction of diagnoses and treatments. A weighted temporal loss further improves the model, which outperforms prior state-of-the-art systems.

items.title: Attack Graph Generation on HPC Clusters
items.title_zh: 在高性能计算集群上生成攻击图
items.summary: The paper proposes generating attack graphs, which model multi-step network attacks, on high-performance computing clusters to address the time and memory costs and state-space explosion that make conventional generation difficult.

items.title: Trust Region Constrained Measure Transport in Path Space for Stochastic Optimal Control and Inference
items.title_zh: 路径空间中信赖域约束的测度传输：随机最优控制与推断
items.summary: The authors propose iteratively solving trust-region-constrained problems to approximate a target path-space measure in stochastic optimal control, framing the process as geometric annealing from the prior. They report significant gains in diffusion-based sampling, transition path sampling and diffusion model fine-tuning.

items.title: A Personalized Exercise Assistant using Reinforcement Learning (PEARL): Results from a four-arm Randomized-controlled Trial
items.title_zh: 基于强化学习的个性化运动助手 PEARL：四臂随机对照试验结果
items.summary: A four-arm randomized controlled trial randomized 13,463 Fitbit users to control, random, fixed, or reinforcement-learning nudges; the RL group showed significantly higher daily step counts at one month than all other groups, including a gain of 296 steps over control, with a smaller sustained advantage at two months.

items.title: An Explainable AI based approach for Monitoring Animal Health
items.title_zh: 一种基于可解释 AI 的动物健康监测方法
items.summary: The study uses accelerometer data from Bluetooth IoT devices and 4G transmission to classify dairy cattle activity with explainable machine learning. A k-nearest neighbour classifier performed best, and SHAP was used to interpret feature importance.

items.title: AI sustains higher strategic tension than humans in chess
items.title_zh: AI 在国际象棋中比人类保持更高的战略张力
items.summary: Using a network-based metric of piece-to-piece interactions, the authors find that elite AI chess players sustain higher strategic tension for longer than top human grandmasters, with cumulative tension scaling with algorithmic complexity in AI and linearly with Elo in human play.
